biometrics.setupFailed: We couldn't set up this device. Try again.

biometrics.notConfirmed: {{label}} wasn't confirmed. Try again, or choose Not now.
biometrics.title: Use {{label}}?
biometrics.intro: Unlock the app and approve payments with {{label}} instead of typing your PIN.
biometrics.privateFace: Your face never leaves this phone. Nem Bank only learns that the check passed.
biometrics.privateFinger: Your fingerprint never leaves this phone. Nem Bank only learns that the check passed.
biometrics.key: This phone gets its own security key, locked behind {{label}}, so payments can only be approved from here.
biometrics.expoGo: Expo Go cannot use Face ID: Apple only lets an app use it when the app asks for it itself. You will use your PIN in this demo; the installed Nem Bank app supports Face ID.
biometrics.web: Browsers cannot use Face ID or fingerprints, so you will use your PIN here. The phone app supports both.
biometrics.none: No Face ID or fingerprint is set up on this device, so you will use your PIN. You can turn it on later in Security.
